item.title: The California State Assembly Has Passed the 'Protect Our Games Act'
item.description:
📝 The bill requires digital game publishers to maintain an environment where games remain accessible even after service is discontinued. The bill applies to digitally sold games. However, it excludes games provided via subscription services, free-to-play games, and games that are inherently playable offline indefinitely.
🔗 Read more: https://www.invenglobal.com/articles/22330/stop-killing-games-movement-gains-momentum-california-assembly-passes-game-protection-bill

item.title: Rothko for your current weather conditions
item.description:
📝 Rothko stopped painting things in the late 1940s. What he kept was light, color, and a feeling the work was supposed to give the person standing in front of it — joy, ecstasy, doom, tragedy. He arranged two or three soft-edged rectangles on a field and worked the surface until the colors seemed to hold their own weather inside the canvas.
🔗 Read more: https://rothko.joonas.wtf/

item.title: Letter from the Duke of Wellington to the British Foreign Office (1809)
item.description:
📝 MESSAGE FROM THE DUKE OF WELLINGTON TO THE BRITISH FOREIGN OFFICE IN LONDON– written from Central Spain, August 1812 Gentlemen, Whilst marching from Portugal to a position which commands the approach to Madrid and the French forces, my officers have been diligently complying with your requests which have been sent by H. Each returned with their military reputations in tatters. All beaten by Wellington.
🔗 Read more: https://wellsoc.org/society-member-pages/anecdotes-of-wellington/

item.title: Show HN: TV Explorer. Adding advanced UI to free online TV
CAPTCHAs can still detect AI agents
item.description:
📝 No, because AI does not complete CAPTCHAs like humans. We found that state-of-the-art frontier models (Claude, GPT, Gemini) have less similar human process features compared to smaller models (Qwen, Centaur). This introduces the second question: how adversarially robust is the process to discriminate humans from agents.
🔗 Read more: https://research.roundtable.ai/captchas-detect-ai/

item.title: Robinhood now lets your AI agents trade stocks
item.description:
📝 With this card, users can connect their AI agents to the company’s banking MCP server to enable them to make payments. item.title: Someone used my open source project to phish people
item.description:
📝 Each account had created one workspace whose name was a complete phishing email subject line, then sent roughly a hundred invitations from that workspace to a list of strangers. The invitation email went out from my verified Resend domain. Disposable email domains blocked.
🔗 Read more: https://andrej.sh/posts/phishing-through-my-open-source-project
